summary: The root نجو (njw) primarily means to escape or be safe. It can also describe swiftness, outstripping others, or, in a more crude sense, voiding excrement or breaking wind.
lane: 1 نَجَا ذ Alvum dejecit; (Msb, TA;) ventumve per anum emisit: (TA:) he voided his ordure; or broke wind. -b2- نَجَا , inf. n. نَجَآءٌ , He was quick, or swift, and outstripped. (S.) See an ex. of the inf. n., voce غولٌ . -b3- نَجَا He became safe, or secure; he escaped. (Msb, &c.)

headwords.def: Alvum dejecit; (Msb, TA;) ventumve per anum emisit: (TA:) he voided his ordure; or broke wind. نَجَا, inf. n. نَجَآءٌ, He was quick, or swift, and outstripped. (S.) See an ex. of the inf. n., voce غولٌ. نَجَا He became safe, or secure; he escaped. (Msb, &c.)
and He saved, him; rescued him; preserved him. (K.)
He washed, or wiped with a stone or a piece of dry clay, the place [ of exit ] of his excrement. (Msb.) اِسْتَنْجَوْا: see 8 in art. سعر.
and نَجَآءٌ A shower of rain. See شُوْبُوبٌ and 1. نجاء A well of which the water is distant [ from the mouth ]. (O, TA, voce قَرَبٌ.)
: see نَجْوَى. عُرْيَانُ النَّجِىِّ: see art. عرى.

Secret discourse between two persons or parties. (TA.) A secret between two persons or parties; as also. (K, TA.) A person, or persons, discoursing secretly, or telling secrets one with another. (TA.)
[ A cause, or means, of safety: of the measure مَفْعَلَةٌ, originally مَنْجَوَةٌ; similar to مَفْلَحَةٌ, &c.]. (S.)
a dial. var. of نَجَوْتُ: see دَوْكَةٌ.
